limitations: No death/unpair events: partnership continuity and parent liveness between samples are not independently observable. Pair events, sampled reciprocity, pairing ticks, and final living reciprocity are checked.
No per-shelter capacity inventory: housing_capacity is an input aggregate. Bedded people, bedless people, unused slots and couple-night denominators are recomputed.
Night bed rows show assigned beds, not actual sleep state or nearest-tile sleeping. No claim about realized sleep follows from this checker.

Departure household/couple arrays are raw snapshots; their counts and membership splits are recomputed. Unsampled departures cannot independently prove the full living settlement census or individual ranking decisions.
This checker does not implement F3 resemblance, confidence intervals, health gates, cohort seed policy, or final acceptance verdicts.
